blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Storage Instructions: Store Culturelle® in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Close cap firmly after use.
Tamper Evident: Do not use this product if safety seal bearing "Sealed For Your Protection" under cap is missing or torn.

Keep out of reach of children. Not intended for children under 3 years of age due to risk of choking. Inform a healthcare professional before starting any dietary supplement, particularly if there is a known immune-compromised condition.

When first taking Culturelle®, your child may experience minor bloating, gas or intestinal gurgling which should subside with continued use. Consult your healthcare professional if symptoms persist after two weeks.
